english.note: For the literal, enduring sense, this is the all-purpose choice for “forever.”
This is the all-purpose choice when something is to last forever or indefinitely.
This is the all-purpose choice for something lasting forever, including 「永遠感激你」.
Use 永遠 for an enduring or timeless ‘always’, especially when it means ‘forever’.

examples.english: I will eternally remember your help today.
examples.traditional: 我永遠都會記住你今日幫我。
